title: NEXUS — Autonomous Executive OS
shortDescription: A multi-agent mesh that acts without being asked. A primary orchestrator routes to planning, learning, life-admin and proactive-monitor sub-agents, with a scheduler watchdog that initiates work on its own. Built for a Google hackathon.
featureHighlights: Orchestrator routing to four sub-agents
LLM router: 8 endpoints across 4 models
Circuit breaker trips instead of burning quota
Guardrail validator on every tool call
MCP bridge to Microsoft Graph and Slack
Missing credentials degrade to 501s

title: Sharda Solutions — Commission Reconciliation
shortDescription: A desktop application that answers one question every month: did I get paid what I earned? It reconciles insurer commission statements and mutual-fund brokerage against the records a distributor actually holds, and names everything that was not paid.
featureHighlights: 32,330 brokerage lines grouped to 1,276 holdings
19 live holdings found earning no brokerage
SCD Type 2 ledger that closes, never deletes
Deterministic no-model path for figures that must tie
Signed native app for macOS and Windows
Distinct-period query cut from 30ms to 0.06ms
availabilityNote: Private — runs on a real distributor’s monthly books. No public repository or demo.

title: AI-Native Job Search CRM
shortDescription: A Chrome extension and local proxy that makes the CRM a byproduct of applying. It tracks applications as they are submitted, vaults the exact resume sent, maps the people you connect with onto those applications, and drafts outreach grounded in your own resume text.
featureHighlights: Two-lens hybrid retrieval, fused by RRF
LLM reranker drops contentless evidence
Every number checked against retrieved text
nDCG@3 lifted 0.544 → 0.710
Committed eval gates fail the build
Never clicks Send, never views a profile

title: EverythinInAI — AI-Tool Discovery Engine
shortDescription: A pipeline that runs around the clock cataloguing the AI tool landscape: collection from GitHub, Hacker News and RSS, a weighted heuristic pre-filter, classification into a nine-way taxonomy, then deduplication. My own idea, from ideology to invention.
featureHighlights: 10,000+ tools catalogued
1,200–2,000 net-new per day
Zero failures over a sustained 24-hour run
Cost-guard breaker refuses calls past a spend cap
Resumable backfill survives a crash mid-run
16 systemd units as configuration-as-code

title: PE Intelligence
shortDescription: English and Hinglish questions turned into SQL over a 1.5-million-row trade warehouse. The model writes the query; the laptop runs it. Only the column names and your question ever leave the machine, so when compliance asks where the data went, the answer is nowhere.
featureHighlights: 1.5M-row warehouse queried in plain English
The privacy firewall — no row ever leaves
Five swappable model backends
~2 second cold start
Zero-terminal install, silent env bootstrap
Hinglish queries supported
availabilityNote: Private — built for a specific operator’s trade data. No public repository or demo.

title: Marque Motors — Automated Lead Ecosystem
shortDescription: A three-part system for a luxury dealership, built in three days as one monorepo. A customer enquiry flows from the public portal, through an automation brain that enriches and scores it, into a secure internal CRM — end to end.
featureHighlights: Portal with its own BFF fusing NHTSA safety data
13-node enrichment and LLM scoring pipeline
CRM with auth, row-level security and realtime
Idempotent upserts on a dedupe key
Retry with back-off, graceful degradation
Built in three days

title: KYB Triage Rulebook
shortDescription: Business onboarding is slow when the criteria live in people’s heads. This writes an AML policy down as rules a script can apply, clears low-risk cases with nobody touching them, and sends everything else to the right person with the reason and an evidence pack.
featureHighlights: Every rule cites a policy clause, or load fails
No model in the decision path — auditable
Hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log
Fails closed; replayable as of any past date
Impact analysis before rulebook sign-off
5 of 6 alerts cleared by rule
